name: marketing-agent
description: Marketing Agent — AI marketing automation for Codex CLI. Audit, optimize, and launch campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo & Search Console — with battle-tested GoMarble methodology built in. 36 model-invoked AI marketing playbooks.

interface.shortDescription: AI marketing agent for paid media — Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo & Search Console. 36 AI marketing playbooks.
interface.longDescription:
Marketing Agent connects Codex to your ad accounts and ships 36 expert-authored AI marketing playbooks so your agent reasons like a senior performance marketer — not a generic chatbot.

• 36 model-invoked skills covering Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax), Meta (Facebook/Instagram), GA4, Shopify, Search Console, Klaviyo, TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing Ads, and document generation (DOCX, PPTX, PDF, XLSX).
• Auto-loaded guardrails — recommendations follow the same constraints GoMarble uses internally (no synthetic data, no fabricated keywords, proper attribution discipline).
• Audit, optimize, and create — pull insights, propose budget moves, build campaigns and ad sets from natural-language briefs.
• OAuth in one click — authorize once via gomarble.ai, then every tool call uses your credentials securely.

Free to install. Connects to your existing GoMarble account (or sign up free at gomarble.ai).
defaultPrompt: Audit my Meta Ads account for the last 30 days.
Pull a 7-day Google Ads performance report and flag campaigns to scale.
Build a new Meta ad set with this creative.
Generate a PPTX deck summarizing all my paid-media performance.
